meta.title: Vegas Field Notes
meta.subtitle: Strip poker tournaments & hotel costs
meta.scope: Selected upcoming Strip-area tournaments and on-property hotel fees verified from official operator and hotel sources. This is a researched snapshot, not a complete room-by-room inventory.
meta.strictEntryRule: A qualifying tournament must explicitly allow only one paid entry per player for the whole event, with no re-entry, rebuy, add-on, or paid extra chips. Missing terms mean unknown, not single-entry.

summary.statusLine: No strict single-entry event confirmed in the reviewed official terms.

criteria: One total paid entry per person for the entire event, not one entry per starting flight.
No re-entry, rebuy, add-on, or other paid route to additional chips or a second live entry.
The upcoming date, venue, start time, and buy-in are published for the event being considered.

hotels.name: The Venetian / The Palazzo
hotels.rate: 2026 poker-player rates advertised from $119 at The Venetian and $209 at The Palazzo; not a date-specific quote.
hotels.perk: Published Venetian Luxury King description: 650 sq ft. Poker rate requires 6 hours of active live cash or a $300+ tournament buy-in for each night; if the play requirement is missed, that night reverts to the prevailing rate.
hotels.caveat: Rate depends on dates, availability, occupancy, and qualifying play; verify booking terms.

flags.title: Strict-entry count is zero confirmed
flags.body: No reviewed official event-specific terms explicitly cap total entries at one per player. Unknown is not a pass. Ask for written confirmation before booking around an event.

flags.title: Venetian one-day sheets omit the entry cap
flags.body: Events #2, #3–5, #6, #10 and #14 are the strongest documented one-day candidates, but their reviewed sheets do not prove no re-entry or add-ons.

flags.title: 8:00 a.m. is an empty slot in this evidence set
flags.body: No 8 a.m. tournament start was verified. The earliest recurring published start is 9 a.m. at Horseshoe; its buy-ins and entry terms are missing.

flags.title: Bellagio Saturday structure is internally inconsistent
flags.body: The official PDF title, filename, and fee allocation conflict on buy-in, and it contains past dates. Do not plan around this event without a corrected official sheet.

flags.title: Some daily schedules are incomplete or stale
flags.body: MGM Grand's linked schedule is labeled August; Horseshoe, ARIA and Westgate lack event-level terms; Bellagio's main page contains old resumption wording. Reconfirm with the room.

flags.title: Exact hotel totals need a trip search
flags.body: Travel dates, stay length, room type, and occupancy were not provided. Resort fees are shown separately; no made-up all-in nightly prices are included.

flags.title: SAHARA poker room closure announced
flags.body: SAHARA's current official page says the poker room closes November 16, 2026. Old schedule text on the page is not treated as a future event.

recommendations.title: Get the entry rule in writing
recommendations.body: Ask the Venetian poker desk whether Event #2 and the $200 RaceDay Stack are one paid entry per player for the entire event, with no re-entry, rebuy, add-on, or optional extra chips. A blank structure sheet is not enough.
recommendations.action: Use the official Venetian event schedule

recommendations.title: Treat a high prize-pool share as fee data only
recommendations.body: Event #10 shows an 83.75% published prize-pool contribution and the RaceDay Stack 82.5%, but neither has confirmed entry restrictions. This is not expected value or proof of a good bet.

recommendations.title: Do not plan for an 8 a.m. start
recommendations.body: None was verified. Horseshoe lists a 9 a.m. recurring tournament, but current buy-in and entry rules are not published in the reviewed official sources.

recommendations.title: Price rooms for the exact nights
recommendations.body: The Venetian / Palazzo poker rates are the most detailed published price lead, not an unconditional quote: the play threshold applies each night and a $300+ tournament entry does not establish that the event is single-entry.
